detail.title: 2+2 MP WizColor Active Deterrance Dual-lens Fixed-focal Pan & Tilt WizSense Network Camera
detail.overview: Compare Favourite IPC-PTS2249B-E2-S-PV-PRO 2+2 MP WizColor Active Deterrance Dual-lens Fixed-focal Pan & Tilt WizSense Network Camera Key Points • Versatile Pan-Tilt for Wide-Area Security Monitoring • Dual Lenses, Double Protection. Dual 2MP Fixed and PT Lenses Protect Two Areas, Reducing Blind Spots • Exceptional Image Quality in Low-Light Environments by WizColor Technology • Deep Learning-Based Human and Vehicle Classification • Instant Sound and Light Alerts Deter Intruders & Reduce Incidents • Supports Max. 256G Micro SD card • Efficient H.264+/H.265+ Compression Technology • IP66 Ratings for Protection Against Harsh Environments Sales Enquiry Datasheet

General.Image Sensor: Channel 1 (PT Lens): 1/2.9" CMOS Channel 2 (Fixed Lens): 1/2.9" CMOS
General.Lens Type: Channel 1 (PT Lens): Fixed-focal Channel 2 (Fixed Lens): Fixed-focal
General.Focal Length: Channel 1 (PT Lens): 3.6 mm Channel 2 (Fixed Lens): 3.6 mm
General.Max. Aperture: Channel 1 (PT Lens): F1.0 Channel 2 (Fixed Lens): F1.0
General.Field of View: Channel 1 (PT Lens): H: 81°; V: 44°; D: 95° Channel 2 (Fixed Lens): H: 81°; V: 44°; D: 95°
General.Close Focus Distance: Channel 1 (PT Lens): 1.7 m (5.58 ft) Channel 2 (Fixed Lens): 1.7 m (5.58 ft)
General.IVS (Perimeter Protection): Intrusion, tripwire (the two functions support the classification and accurate detection of vehicle and human)
General.Smart Search: Work together with Smart NVR to perform refine intelligent search, event extraction and merging to event videos
General.Video Compression: H.265; H.264; H.264H; H.264B; MJPEG (Only supported by sub stream)
General.Video Frame Rate: Channel 1 (PT Lens): Main stream: 1920 × 1080@(1–25/30 fps) sub stream: 704 × 576@(1–25 fps)/704 × 480@(1–30 fps) Channel 2 (Fixed Lens): Main stream: 1920 × 1080@(1–25/30 fps) sub stream: 704 × 576@(1–25 fps)/704 × 480@(1–30 fps) *The values above are the max. frame rates of each stream; for multiple streams, the values will be subjected to the total encoding capacity.
General.Video Bit Rate: H.264: 32 kbps–4096 kbps; H.265: 12 kbps–4096 kbps
General.White Balance: Auto; natural; street lamp; outdoor; manual; regional custom
General.Alarm Event: No SD card; SD card full; SD card error; network disconnection; IP conflict; illegal access; motion detection; video tampering; tripwire; intrusion; audio detection; voltage detection; SMD; security exception
General.Network Protocol: IPv4; IPv6; HTTP; TCP; UDP; ARP; RTP; RTSP; RTCP; RTMP; SMTP; FTP; SFTP; DHCP; DNS; DDNS; QoS; UPnP; NTP; Multicast; ICMP; IGMP; NFS; PPPoE; P2P; Bonjour; Auto Registration
General.Security: Digest; WSSE; Account lockout; Security logs; IP/MAC filtering; Generation and importing of X.509 certification; syslog; HTTPS; 802.1x; Trusted boot; Trusted execution; Trusted upgrade; Session security; Security warning
General.Interoperability: ONVIF (Profile S & Profile G & Profile T); CGI
General.Storage: FTP; SFTP; Micro SD card (support max. 256 GB); NAS
General.Light Warning: Warm light warning Flash/Solid on duration: 5 s–30 s Flash frequency: high, medium, low
General.Sound Warning: Offers 3 sound alarms and supports importing custom sound alarms. Sound: 0–100. Play times can be set from 1 to 10.
General.Pan/Tilt Range: Channel 1 (PT Lens): Pan: 0° to 350°; Tilt: 0° to 90°; Channel 2 (Fixed Lens): Pan: 0° to 326°; Tilt: –10° to 15°
General.Certifications: CE-LVD: EN62368-1; CE-EMC: Electromagnetic Compatibility Directive 2014/30/EU
General.Power Consumption: Basic: 2.3 W (12 VDC); 3.1 W (PoE); Max.: 9.2 W (12 VDC); 10.5 W (PoE) (intelligence on + WDR + illuminator on + PT rotation + speaker on)
